Capabilities

What we deliver

Azure Databricks & lakehouse architecture

Medallion-structured lakehouses on Delta Lake with Unity Catalog governance, built for batch and incremental loads.

Azure Databricks • Delta Lake • Unity Catalog

Data pipelines & orchestration

Selected experience

Experience from enterprise data programmes

Modernisation

Legacy ETL → Azure Databricks Lakehouse

Reporting

How this estimate is calculated

  • Annual savings = €4,800 per TB of monthly data volume + a fixed base of €2,200.
  • Query speed-up = 2.5× base + 0.35× per TB of monthly data volume.
  • These are fixed reference coefficients, not measurements of your environment. Your current architecture, workload patterns, cloud pricing and contracts are not taken into account.

* Illustrative estimate only — not a quote, forecast or guarantee of results. A short assessment of your environment is needed for a realistic figure.
